R_AUTH.statement: Applicability: Whenever membership eligibility is required Retain registry member/decision identity and eligible, ineligible or unavailable outcome; neither service nor volunteer creates a positive decision.

R_WAIT.statement: Applicability: When no candidate tool exists Offer wait-list or closure at member choice without a reservation or decrease of available inventory.

R_GATE.statement: Applicability: Before preparing a ready reservation The selected member is eligible and selected tool fit, with matching decision/inspection identities; unavailable remains pending, ineligible remains accountable, unfit is quarantined.

R_NOTICE.statement: Applicability: When communicating ready status Identify the ready tool, collection location and hold deadline; retain queueing and confirmed delivery as different events.

R_HOLD.statement: Applicability: After confirmed delivery unless member withdraws or a new tool fault is discovered Hold the ready reservation for at least two hours measured from confirmed notice delivery, not queued-notice time.

R_NO_ACK.statement: Applicability: When delivery confirmation is absent Keep pending-notification and coordinator contact resolution; do not expire using an assumed delivery time.

R_EXTEND.statement: Applicability: After deadline passes without collection Only return a still-fit tool to available or extend with a recorded coordinator reason; retain withdrawal and fault as distinct causes.

R_CUSTODY.statement: Applicability: Before recording the tool on loan Require member/tool matching, accepted loan terms and receipt of the identified tool; record library-to-member custody then on-loan state. Ready notice, eligibility or presentation alone cannot complete transfer.

R_RECEIPT.statement: Applicability: When accepting return of a tool Record steward-confirmed identified receipt and library custody; member return report alone is insufficient.

R_REPAIR.statement: Applicability: When a repair report arrives Steward reassesses condition; completion wording or unresolved defects cannot establish fit or lending availability.

R_RELEASE.statement: Applicability: Before releasing quarantine Require steward fit assessment and coordinator release decision; remaining defects retain quarantine and require a separate rework/retirement decision.

R_INVENTORY.statement: Applicability: Whenever inventory candidates are offered An identified tool is not offered as available while reserved, on loan, awaiting returned-tool assessment or quarantined.

R_RECORDS.statement: Applicability: While coordinating a tool/request case Retain tool identity, custody, condition, reservation linkage and unresolved exceptions for steward/coordinator work.

R_OUTCOME.statement: Applicability: When request status changes Communicate current pending, ready, refused, extended or closed outcome without inferring loan/repair success from notification.

boundary: Generated reconciliation expectations check recipe-to-language translation. They are not independent source-meaning acceptance or executed verification.
